Claim 1 (Currently amended): A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder selected from the group consisting of a premixed solder paste and epoxy; and a solvent.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface selected from the group consisting of silicon chips and other electronic components.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface, wherein the removal occurs by heating the electronic component surface.
